note: F28's non-tariff income: its seventeen heads to its total, carried to the ARR format's row 50; telecom and other business to row 49; the two to the format's last total.  Columns: FY2023-24 claimed, FY2024-25 approved in the FY2024-25 order (one figure, 53.01, entered on the first head — A82) and claimed, FY2025-26 estimated, FY2026-27 projected.  The APR column's approved 63.99 is typed as a total with no heads, and the audited column is empty: neither is reproduced.
